verdict.rationale: Bruno's marketing site claims it can 'serve realistic mock responses while you build' (bruno-docs-4), which directly supports a mock-server capability, but there is no further documentation on how mocks are configured (from saved examples, specs, or otherwise), no CLI/spec-based generation details, and no community corroboration of this feature in practice. missing for 10: detailed docs on mock configuration/spec-driven generation, independent/hands-on validation of the mocking feature, examples of using saved request examples as mock responses.
